dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Features multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings with high-intensity, jagged perimeters surrounding darker interiors. Significant structures include a large mid-dorsal 'O' ring and an anterior interlocking double-ring structure.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Dense clusters of solid high-intensity white pixel blobs are concentrated along the dorsal ridge and scattered in the posterior region, with minimal internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the anterior double-annulus, the mid-dorsal ring, and a posterior-lateral annulus form a scalene triangle with the most acute angle at the posterior-lateral vertex.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique interlocking figure-eight annulus pattern visible in the anterior-dorsal quadrant.
